metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds one turn of a sermon, the pew in the north aisle, and the letter on the board.

yesterday: The glass turned once. The parish was more frightened by the shortness than a long sermon would have made it.
You saw the pew in the north aisle. The mark is for a day you see her or hear her.
The memo after dinner joined the people who have gone into the country with the boy you are writing.
The loaf is still a thumb short of the notch. The letter is on the board.
